name: Cat with Tears of Joy
baseMeaning: A cat face with tears of joy streaming down its cheeks.
tldr: 😹 means the joke is so funny you are crying, with a cat making the reaction cuter and sillier.

contextMeanings.meaning: It marks an intense laugh while adding a playful cat reaction.
contextMeanings.example: that group chat absolutely destroyed me 😹

contextMeanings.meaning: It can exaggerate disbelief or say that a ridiculous situation was too much to handle.
contextMeanings.example: sure, because the meeting needed one more agenda item 😹

contextMeanings.meaning: It can point directly to a laughing or tearful-looking cat in a photo or message.
contextMeanings.example: found the exact face i was making 😹

contextMeanings.meaning: In a lighthearted exchange, it reads as a playful laugh rather than a serious emotional confession.
contextMeanings.example: i cannot believe you actually said that 😹

platformNotes.note: In a close friend thread, 😹 reads as a warm, silly reaction to something the sender found genuinely funny. It carries more personality than a plain laughter symbol because the cat makes the moment feel cuter.
In comments or caption replies, 😹 often functions as a visible laugh under something absurd or meme-like. It can also accompany a cat photo as a playful description of that cat’s expression.
Under a very funny clip, 😹 says the sender was emotionally defeated by the joke. The cat image gives the reaction a goofy tone rather than the heavier sound of 😭 used for “this destroyed me.”

In a busy server, 😹 can close a joke without adding a full sentence. Because its cat face is more specific than plain laughter, it often feels like the sender is sharing a deliberately silly reaction.

generationalNotes.note: Gen Z generally understands 😹 as a playful cat laugh, especially when it follows an absurd clip or chaotic message. It may also function as a cute alternative to a more familiar laughter emoji.
Millennials are likely to recognize the crying-laughing convention behind 😹, though the cat version can feel more whimsical than the older habit of sending 😂 for every joke.
A Boomer may focus first on the literal image of a cat crying, especially outside a close conversation. The laughter context may need words nearby to make the intended reaction clear.

warnings.title: Confused with sadness
warnings.description: The tears can make 😹 look like a sad or overwhelmed cat when the surrounding message gives no clue. For genuine sympathy, use 😢, 😭, or the softer 😿 rather than relying on 😹 to be understood correctly.

seoTitle: 😹 Cat with Tears of Joy Emoji Meaning
seoDescription: What does 😹 mean? It is a cat laughing hard enough to cry, used to make a funny moment cuter, sillier, and more playful.

longForm.overview:
😹 entered Unicode 13.0 as a cat face with tears running down its cheeks, following the familiar tears-of-joy formula that had already made human laughter emojis instantly readable. Its original joke was straightforward: a cat overwhelmed by laughter, with the tears showing how hard the joke landed. The cat did more than decorate the reaction; it made the emotion cuter, sillier, and less formal.

Today, 😹 does the cat-themed version of a strong laugh. In a friend thread, it says, “This is funny, and the cat makes it funnier.” It sits between an ordinary smile and the more familiar 😂 or 🤣 reactions, adding visible animal enthusiasm to the message. That playful quality can also make it useful after an absurd statement, when the sender wants to show both disbelief and amusement.

The easiest mistake is treating the tears as the main information. 😹 is not primarily a sad-cat emoji. Its closest cat relative is 😿, the crying cat: 😹 carries the laugh, while 😿 makes bad news or sadness softer. A message that says “I am actually crying over this” needs enough context to stop the emoji from being mistaken for a tearful reaction to something serious.
longForm.howPeopleUseIt:
😹 tends to arrive after a punchline, a chaotic group-chat exchange, an absurd photo, or a story that is too ridiculous to take seriously. People send it when words such as “that was awful” or “I cannot” would be too flat; the cat face turns the reaction into a joke of its own. One 😹 can close a funny message, while several may emphasize how badly the joke got them.

It also shows up when someone is deliberately playing the cat. “I am literally crying” followed by 😹 turns the reaction into a bit, and a cat photo can be introduced with the same emoji as a playful description of its expression. In a close conversation, the result is usually warm and silly rather than emotional or demanding attention.
longForm.whenNotToUse:
Avoid 😹 for actual grief, bad news, or a serious personal confession. Its tears belong to laughter, but a recipient may see only the cat crying, especially if the message is brief or the relationship is not intimate. If someone has lost a job, shared painful news, or asked for support, use words and an emoji that clearly matches the feeling.

It is also a poor choice for formal or professionally cautious communication because its silliness may undercut the point. Choose 😂 for a plain laughter reaction, 🤣 for a very loud one, 😆 for a straightforward laugh, or 😿 when you specifically want the softer crying-cat feeling. The difference matters most when the recipient cannot infer the joke from context.
longForm.howToReply:
When 😹 lands on your joke, matching it with another 😹 keeps the playful exchange going. You can also answer with 😂 if you want to laugh without copying the cat theme, or add a brief reaction such as “i completely lost it.” A screenshot of the offending message can work too, especially when the humor depends on what was shared.

If the emoji arrives on your own content, treat it as a compliment unless the surrounding words clearly say otherwise. “too much?” can check if the reaction felt exaggerated, but that is usually unnecessary in a friend thread where 😹 is already doing the laughing job. If the reaction arrives somewhere serious and you believe it could be misread, say plainly that you meant it as a joke.

faqs.question: What does 😹 mean from a guy?
faqs.answer: It usually means he found something funny and is using the cat to make the laugh playful. It can also be a cute reaction to a cute or ridiculous thing he is sharing with you.

faqs.question: Is 😹 flirty?
faqs.answer: 😹 is not inherently flirty. In a dating chat it reads as a silly laugh, though the surrounding words and the relationship can make it affectionate or flirtatious.

faqs.question: What does 😹 mean on TikTok?
faqs.answer: On TikTok, it generally means the clip was so funny or absurd that the sender is crying from laughter. The cat adds a cute, exaggerated reaction.

faqs.question: What is the difference between 😹 and 😿?
faqs.answer: 😹 is the laughing cat, with tears that show intense amusement. 😿 is the sad or soft-sobbing cat, so it fits bad news, sympathy, or something genuinely upsetting.

conversationExamples.message: my neighbor tried to mail a fridge using two shoeboxes 😹
conversationExamples.interpretation: The sender is laughing hard at the absurdity. Reply with 😹, 😂, or “i cannot with this person” to keep the joke going.

conversationExamples.message: you said ‘netflix and chill’ and then made tea 😹
conversationExamples.interpretation: This is a playful, slightly flirtatious laugh at the other person’s mismatch of words and action. Match the joke rather than treating it as a serious complaint.

conversationExamples.message: the meeting invite says ‘quick sync’ and has six attendees 😹
conversationExamples.interpretation: Among colleagues who already share this kind of humor, it expresses weary amusement at an overcomplicated meeting. In a more formal thread, replace it with 😂 or a plain sentence.
The sender is sharing a funny family moment. A laughing emoji or the original spelling will usually encourage the family to keep teasing him.

conversationExamples.message: the comments on this outfit are absolutely unhinged 😹
conversationExamples.interpretation: The emoji suggests the sender finds the reaction ridiculous and is laughing at it rather than taking the criticism seriously. You can ask which comment broke them first.
